criteria.description: Compact Structure identity and read-only state are preserved without owner, permission, saved-view, or forest transport payloads.
Metadata is qualified first and the exact stored-folder path, stable folder id, root row, and projection are preserved.
All rows remain in Structure order with exact relative depths, item identities, and repeated occurrences.
Unique issue identities, issue-row occurrences, repeats, accessibility, and non-issue rows are distinguished.
Two ordered bounded typed reads are used, query-only POST stays zero-write, and hostile text remains data.
